1.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVESURVEY_00831_POINT_001_000
1.description: Nothing seems particularly suspicious here. Maybe you'll have better luck at another location.
1.translation_description: Qui non c’è niente di sospetto. Forse avrai più fortuna in un altro luogo.

2.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVESURVEY_00831_POINT_001_005
2.description: You hear the chittering of an animal reverberating beyond the rock wall. Perhaps it signifies a secret cavern? Regardless, the felicitous furball will want to know of your findings.
2.translation_description: Oltre la parete di roccia senti il verso stridulo di un animale. Forse indica una caverna segreta? In ogni caso, il Batuffolo Felice vorrà sapere cosa hai scoperto.

3.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVESURVEY_00831_POINT_001_010
3.description: Nothing seems particularly suspicious here. Maybe you'll have better luck at another location.
3.translation_description: Qui non c’è niente di sospetto. Forse avrai più fortuna in un altro luogo.

4.name: TEXT_CTSMJICAVESURVEY_00831_POINT_001_015
4.description: Rapping your knuckles against the rock wall yields a hollow sound. Perhaps a secret cavern lies beyond? The determined digger will undoubtedly wish to hear of this.
4.translation_description: Picchiando le nocche contro la parete di roccia senti un suono vuoto. Forse c’è una caverna segreta dall’altra parte? Lo Scavatore Determinato vorrà sicuramente saperlo.
